The task would accept Open and reject In Progress, which is inconsistent.","suggested_fix":"Change the task to return an invalid input error for any status value other than Completed, matching AC6."},{"check_id":"CRIT-CONSTRAINT","severity":"blocking","item_key":"US-update-task","requirement_ids":["R-ab9e9cb0","R-d57336f7"],"message":"The story cites R-ab9e9cb0 (no optimistic UI) and the edit form must show success or error messages. The story's ACs and tasks cover messages (AC2, AC3), but the story does not cite R-d57336f7, and the QA/FE tasks do not link it, so traceability for the message requirement is missing.","suggested_fix":"Add R-d57336f7 to the requirements of US-change-task-status, FE-status-toggle-control and QA-status-change-test-suite."},{"check_id":"CRIT-UNTESTABLE-AC","severity":"warning","item_key":"US-sort-report-tasks","requirement_ids":["R-d482bfea"],"message":"AC2, AC3, AC4 and AC6 say rows are 'reordered by the field' or 'ordered by that field' without stating the direction or the Status/Priority order, so a tester cannot decide whether the result is correct. The PRD does not define the direction.","suggested_fix":"State the sort direction in each AC (for example ascending by default, with an explicit order for Status and Priority values) or mark the order as an open question for the team to decide before the AC is testable."},{"check_id":"CRIT-OVERLAP","severity":"warning","item_key":"BE-status-change-error-handling","requirement_ids":["R-9dc414dc"],"message":"The task adds not-found and invalid-input handling to the status change endpoint, which BE-status-change-endpoint already creates. It is a small split of one endpoint's work, and the endpoint task does not mention the error cases, so ownership of validation is unclear.","suggested_fix":"Merge the error handling into BE-status-change-endpoint, or state clearly in that task that error responses belong to BE-status-change-error-handling."}]}
